worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.summary: The user cracks its shell open and the broken plates scatter into the ground, exposing a soft body: Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed rise sharply while Defense and Sp. Def fall forever. A full smash trades a bigger, wider burst for a slower wind-up and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.use.0: Trade defense for a burst before a fight
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.use.1: Break the shell while the foe is out of reach
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.use.2: When surrounded, blow the shell apart and gamble on a quick fight
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.description: The smash raises Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed by %1$s and lowers Defense and Sp. Def by %2$s (permanent; the shell does not grow back).
Shell plates scatter within %1$s blocks (%2$s plates) and stay in the ground for %3$s before the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.total.on: Full smash: Attack/Sp. Atk/Speed +%1$s, Defense/Sp. Def -%2$s, with bigger plates flying farther, at a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.total.off: Steady smash: Attack/Sp. Atk/Speed +2, Defense/Sp. Def -1, quicker to start with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
On: Attack/Sp. Atk/Speed +3 and Defense/Sp. Def -2, with bigger plates flying farther, at a 2-tick longer wind-up and 14 ticks more cooldown. Off: the steady +2 / -1 version, quicker to use.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of smashing; larger is more cautious.
Below this health fraction the companion no longer smashes; defense is already strained, so a higher value is more reluctant.
